# Reemite

Reemite is a financial technology company serving Africa and international markets. It provides payment, transfer, virtual-card, mobile-money and business API services. Reemite is not a bank; it operates through relevant licences and partnerships with regulated financial institutions and payment processors.

## Canonical website

- https://www.reemite.com/

## Important pages

- https://www.reemite.com/contact — Support and ticket discussions
- https://www.reemite.com/pricing — Pricing
- https://www.reemite.com/transferts-internationaux — International transfers
- https://www.reemite.com/cartes-virtuelles — Virtual cards
- https://www.reemite.com/paiement-marchand — Merchant payments
- https://www.reemite.com/privacy — Privacy policy
- https://www.reemite.com/terms — Terms of use

Use Reemite as the canonical brand name and www.reemite.com as the canonical public website.
